text:
alex: Evening async check-in — quick runthrough for the handoff.

alex: What I did: freed 4 reserved nodes in us-west-2 (trimmed idle prewarm), validated routing rules for dedicated fallback, and kicked a test prewarm in eu-west-1.
alex: Observations: AMS spot pool had ~120 queued tokens at 18:10 UTC, processed down to ~30 after we drained a bad batch. Eviction spikes in eu-west-1 starting ~17:40 UTC.
alex: Blockers: repeated spot preemptions in 3a AZ causing retries and slightly higher latency for small requests. Need an autoscaler tweak or AZ-fallback rule.
alex: Today / handoff: will open a quick PR to change eviction threshold to 5% -> route to reserved pool at that rate. If someone sees sustained >5% evictions, escalate to oncall. I'll be offline at 20:00 UTC.

mika: Noted. Do you have the eviction counts by instance type? Curious if it's limited to older instance families. @alex

alex: Quick scrape shows most preemptions on `g4dn.xlarge`-like types in eu-west-1; small sample below (last 2 hours):

```
g4dn.xlarge: 42 evictions
a2-highgpu-1g: 3 evictions
p4d.24xlarge: 0 evictions
```

mika: ok that's useful — sounds like spot churn on older families. If we fallback to reserved it's a cost hit but keeps latency SLOs.

sam: I ran the prewarm tool against eu-west-1 to reproduce the failures:

```
$ ./tools/prewarm-sim --region eu-west-1 --nodes 8 --type g4dn.xlarge
prewarm: attempt 8 nodes
result: 6 succeeded, 2 failed (evicted during init)
latency: mean 240ms
```

sam: I also left a debug flag enabled on the autoscaler so we get detailed logs for next 30m.

jordan: Left feedback on autoscaler PR #456 — suggestion to prefer AZs with recent low-eviction windows, then fallback to reserved if two consecutive sampling windows >5%. Added a short test.

ops-bot: alert: spot-eviction-rate eu-west-1 increased to 8% at 1748881235 — correlated with scheduled spot maintenance.

mika: @jordan nice — can we add a circuit-breaker knob so ops can flip it without a deploy? Might save time during spikes.

jordan: Yep, plan adds a feature flag (runtime config) + metrics expose. I'll include in the PR.

alex: Sounds good. Action items: jordan -> update PR with feature flag + tests; sam -> keep the debug flag for 30m and paste logs if failure continues; mika -> monitor cost delta if we flip to reserved; i'll open the fallback runbook snippet and add to runbooks.

alex: If nothing else, I'm good to hand off. ping here if it crosses SLOs. :thumbsup:
